findings: In `components`, both 田 and 土 are only analyzed as pictorial elements of 里, but neither component has a cited sound comparison. The dossier provides modern Mandarin readings for 田 (tián) and 里 (lǐ) in E7, but that pair alone does not establish a phonetic role; do not add one without evidence. The dossier’s supported construction is the traditional 田-plus-土 semantic analysis, with both elements contributing to the interpretation of habitation (E3, X-0b8f79936af15837cd94, X-baca7d413f9e6726db6d). Revise the component roles/explanations to represent that semantic construction, rather than claiming each part depicts an object in 里’s original scene.
